description: This file contains implementation of classes and methods related to radio bearer configuration in 3GPP NR (New Radio) protocol stack, including enums, sequence packing/unpacking, JSON serialization, and class methods for radio bearer configuration structures.

classes.name: ciphering_algorithm_opts
classes.description: Enumeration options for ciphering algorithms with methods to convert to string and number.

classes.name: ul_data_split_thres_opts
classes.description: Enumeration options for UL-DataSplitThreshold with methods for string and numeric conversion.

classes.name: discard_timer_ext_r16_opts
classes.description: Enumeration options for discard timer extension r16 with methods for string and numeric conversion.

classes.name: ethernet_hdr_compress_r16_s
classes.description: Sequence class for Ethernet Header Compression r16, including pack/unpack and JSON serialization methods.

classes.name: ul_data_compress_r17_c
classes.description: Choice class for uplink data compression r17, supporting different setup types and JSON serialization.

classes.name: pdu_set_discard_r18_opts
classes.description: Enumeration options for PDU set discard in r18.

classes.name: discard_timer_for_low_importance_r18_opts
classes.description: Enumeration options for discard timer for low importance in r18.

classes.name: pdcp_cfg_s
classes.description: Structure representing PDCP configuration with methods for packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: srb_to_add_mod_s
classes.description: Structure for SRB addition/modification, including JSON serialization.

classes.name: sdap_cfg_s
classes.description: Structure for SDAP configuration with pack/unpack and JSON methods.

classes.name: drb_to_add_mod_s
classes.description: Structure for DRB addition/modification with methods for JSON serialization.

classes.name: security_algorithm_cfg_s
classes.description: Structure for security algorithm configuration with pack/unpack and JSON methods.

classes.name: security_cfg_s
classes.description: Structure for overall security configuration with pack/unpack and JSON serialization.

classes.name: tmgi_r17_s
classes.description: Sequence class for TMGI in r17, with pack/unpack and JSON serialization.

classes.name: plmn_id_r17_c_
classes.description: Helper class for PLMN ID choice in r17, supporting JSON serialization.

classes.name: mrb_to_add_mod_r17_s
classes.description: Sequence class for MRB addition/modification in r17, with pack/unpack and JSON serialization.

classes.name: radio_bearer_cfg_s
classes.description: Main class for radio bearer configuration, including lists of SRB/DRB, security, and extension handling, with pack/unpack and JSON serialization.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Converts enum options to string representation.

methods.name: to_number
methods.description: Converts enum options to numeric value.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the structure into bit stream.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the structure from bit stream.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the structure into JSON format.
